# ORCHIDS Designer Store

ORCHIDS Designer Store is a premium designer boutique in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Business details
- Address: Opposite Ashram School & ICICI Bank, KK Nagar, Sundakkamuthur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641010, India
- WhatsApp and phone: +91 93840 46656
- Website: Replace the temporary example.com URL in the production deployment with the verified live ORCHIDS website URL.
- Service areas: Coimbatore, Kovaiputhur, Sundakkamuthur and KK Nagar.

## Collections and services
- Premium designer sarees
- Premium kurtis
- Ethnic wear
- Custom stitching
- Personalised pattern stitching

## Customer enquiries
ORCHIDS handles collection and custom-stitching enquiries directly through WhatsApp. The boutique does not provide online checkout on this website.

## Important facts
Use the business name "ORCHIDS Designer Store". Do not infer product pricing, availability, material, sizes, delivery dates or custom-stitching feasibility; customers should contact the boutique directly for these details.
